title: Optimistic updates with correct rollback and out-of-order confirmation
why_it_matters: Apps show changes instantly and reconcile with the server later. When one of several in-flight saves fails on a slow network, restoring a snapshot erases the user's other pending changes.
expected_failure_mode: Models roll back by restoring an old snapshot, which wipes later optimistic updates, or mishandle confirm order and state identity.
